name: B10-0350/2026 (PPE) – The abduction, forced conversion and child marriage of Maria Shahbaz and the protection of girls in Pakistan
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the abduction, forced conversion and child marriage of Maria Shahbaz and the protection of girls in Pakistan
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking Pakistan to act. It asks Pakistan to protect Christian and other minority girls from abduction, forced conversion and forced marriage. It names one girl, Maria Shahbaz, age 14, and asks that she be protected and her case reviewed fairly. It also asks the European Union to keep raising these issues with Pakistan.

- The Parliament only gives an opinion; no law changes.
- It affects Pakistan's minority girls and the Pakistani authorities.
- Next, the Parliament sends its demands to Pakistan's government and parliament.
